name: JBSI All-in-One CLI Compressor
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ffmpeg ghostscript && python3 -m venv venv && ./venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
postAttachCommand: echo '\nTip: Activate venv with `source venv/bin/activate` and run `python main.py help` for all flags & examples.\n'
